news.title: Federal Reserve ends 2018 enforcement action
news.description: The Federal Reserve terminated its 2018 enforcement action after determining that Wells Fargo had met all required conditions for governance and risk management improvements.

profile.description: A diversified financial services company serving consumers, small businesses, institutions, and corporations with banking, lending, investment, and mortgage services.

strengths.title: #4 U.S. bank by assets
strengths.description: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. ranks fourth among U.S. domestically chartered commercial banks by consolidated assets.

strengths.title: 4,128 domestic branches
strengths.description: A large U.S. banking network spanning consumer, business, and institutional customers.

strengths.title: Fortune 500 · No. 38
strengths.description: Wells Fargo reported ranking No. 38 on Fortune’s 2026 list of America’s largest corporations.

companies.name: NetJets
companies.marketNote: NetJets is a privately held subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway. The stock tile shows its parent company, NYSE: BRK.B.

news.title: FlightPulse brings safety insights to pilots
news.description: NetJets introduced the FlightPulse app to give its pilots additional safety insights, becoming the first shared ownership provider to implement the app.

news.title: Starlink connectivity planned across the fleet
news.description: NetJets announced an agreement with Starlink to bring high-speed Wi-Fi to approximately 600 aircraft across its global fleet by the end of 2026.

profile.description: A Berkshire Hathaway subsidiary providing private aviation through fractional aircraft ownership, jet cards, and aircraft management. Its shared fleet gives customers access to private flights without owning and operating an entire aircraft.
highlights: Fractional ownership and jet card programs

strengths.title: World’s largest private jet fleet
strengths.description: NetJets describes its 1,000+ aircraft fleet as the largest and most diverse private fleet in the world.

strengths.title: Access across 200+ countries and territories
strengths.description: Owners can access more than 5,000 airports worldwide, including destinations beyond major airline networks.

strengths.title: A Berkshire Hathaway company
strengths.description: NetJets is listed among Berkshire Hathaway’s subsidiary companies, linking its private aviation business to the wider operating group.

news.title: First Republic acquisition announced
news.description: JPMorganChase acquired the substantial majority of First Republic Bank’s assets and assumed its deposits and certain other liabilities from the FDIC.

profile.description: A global financial services firm bringing together Chase consumer and business banking with J.P. Morgan investment banking, markets, payments, asset management, and private banking.

strengths.title: #1 U.S. bank by assets
strengths.description: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. leads the Federal Reserve’s ranking of U.S. domestically chartered commercial banks by consolidated assets.

strengths.title: #5 globally by assets
strengths.description: JPMorganChase ranks fifth in S&P Global Market Intelligence’s 2026 global bank ranking, based primarily on year-end 2025 financial statements.

strengths.title: #1 in global investment-banking fees
